definitions.explanation: The person officially registered as the representative of a household, particularly in administrative and legal contexts such as the resident register ({住民票|じゅうみんひょう}).

examples.japanese: {世帯主|せたいぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the name of the head of household.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{世帯主|せたいぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}た→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧。
examples.english: When we moved, we filed a change of head of household.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世帯主|せたいぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{続柄|つづきがら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The resident register lists the relationship to the head of household.

notes:
USAGE:
{世帯主|せたいぬし} is a formal, administrative term used on government forms, tax documents, and official registrations. It refers to the person listed as the representative of a household (⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧) in the municipal resident register.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世帯主|せたいぬし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (change of head of household)
- {世帯主|せたいぬし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{続柄|つづきがら} (relationship to head of household)
- {世帯主|せたいぬし}{名|めい} (name of head of household, on forms)
